findings.claim: Section 7 P3 and Section 16 require the charge gate's ledger-lineage evidence to be a gap-free `ExecutionTransitionReceipt` hash/sequence chain and a `ExecutionTransitionReceipt` schema/validator, but no artifact of that name is defined anywhere in v15; Section 9.1 defines only `ExecutionTransitionIntent` plus `ExecutionTransitionCompletion`, so the exact evidence artifact P3 must verify is undefined.
findings.evidence_excerpt: the complete gap-free Section 9.1 `ExecutionTransitionReceipt` hash/sequence chain covering every charge and ordinary status/outcome/review/acceptance write
findings.impact: P3 is the admission invariant that must prove gap-free ledger lineage before every charge, yet the artifact it names is undefined; a WBS closure matrix or bootstrap could declare a `ExecutionTransitionReceipt` schema other than the Section 9.1 `ExecutionTransitionIntent`+`ExecutionTransitionCompletion` pair (for example the superseded post-write-only receipt), letting P3 pass without the pre-write intent evidence required by run-015 f003 and exposing the charge path to an unproven or partial-commit lineage, while Section 16's entry criterion cannot be satisfied literally.
findings.recommended_action: Rename every `ExecutionTransitionReceipt` reference (Section 7 P3 line 283, Section 5.2 step 8 line 181, Section 10 line 367, Section 14 line 445, Section 16 line 489) to the Section 9.1 `ExecutionTransitionIntent`/`ExecutionTransitionCompletion` pair, or define `ExecutionTransitionReceipt` exactly once as that pair and require its schema/validator in Sections 6.1(h) and 16.

rejected_candidates.reason: Section 7.1 orders WBS candidate drafting after reviewed design closure and HUMAN drafting authority, while Section 16 conditions drafting on completed migration and bootstrap; the orderings differ, but drafting is uncharged and grants no selection, approval, admission or attempt authority and admission still fails closed at P3/P15, so no reading permits charge, reuse, acceptance change, undeclared effects or non-HUMAN authority; not material.
